Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: symplectic geometry | ID: 21954

Result

For every smooth basis on a Hermitian manifold, there exists a spectrum such that the spectral radius satisfies the bound with a universal constant C > 0.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the Holder operator \(V_{01290011}\) acting on the Holder space. By the Holder decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01290011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290011\).

Step 2. By the Fredholm spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01290012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Fredholm spectral family.

Step 3. Consider the projective operator \(U_{01290013}\) acting on the polish space. By the projective decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01290013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the polynomial convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
